Two php measurements disagree about `ftruncate`: on its own php KEEPS the buffer across one (it
served bytes the truncation had already removed), yet in

sequences differ by the calls in between — `fflush()` and `flock()` — so the buffer is emptied by
something else, and guessing which would be a fix aimed at the wrong call.

The sequence is replayed with `feof()` after every step, under php, so the emptying call names
